description: Core high school and AP Stats-ready foundations

cards.back: Mean uses all values and is sensitive to outliers; median is middle value and is more robust.
Measures typical spread of data around the mean.
IQR = Q3 - Q1, spread of middle 50% of data.
Potential outliers are below Q1 - 1.5*IQR or above Q3 + 1.5*IQR.
P(event) = favorable outcomes / total equally likely outcomes.
P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B).
If A and B are independent, P(A and B) = P(A)*P(B).
P(A|B) = P(A and B)/P(B), with P(B)>0.
E(X) = sum of each outcome times its probability.
Fixed number of trials, independent trials, two outcomes, constant success probability.
About 68% within 1 SD, 95% within 2 SD, 99.7% within 3 SD.
r measures direction and strength of linear association, from -1 to 1.
A relationship between variables does not prove one causes the other.
Best-fit line that minimizes sum of squared residuals.
Bias occurs when sample method systematically excludes part of population.
